lines.t: As I'm walking down the street, I see people staring at me
Looking at me funny, thinking I'm strange
Because I follow you, yeah, who's your wife?
They tell me to stop
Not to speak, but I say I won't
That my faith's not weak
That you're the one I love
More than all that I'll walk with you
I will not fall
They laugh, they scoff
Tell me to stop
But I close my eyes, I shut my ears
To all the noise I don't wanna hear
I'll always walk with you, you're sure
I'll be strange and peculiar
I'll always follow you
Till you
Remain true
Joshua
With you I'm forever
Abound
With you my heart is sound
And you my faith is found
I don't care what this world says
If they tell me to stop
I won't when they tell me
To turn away from you
I don't ask you
I'll always walk with you
I hear whispers in the night
Voices calling out to me
Trying to pull me away
But I hold on tight
Yeah, I was sure in your light
I stand tall when the shadows try to bite
I'll walk boldly through it all
With every step I take, I feel your presence near
In the quiet of the storm, your voice is all I hear
They laugh, they scoff, tell me to stop
But I close my eyes, I shut my ears
To all the noise I don't wanna hear
I'll always walk with you, yes you are
I'll be strange and peculiar
I'll always follow you
To you I'll remain true
Yeah, I'm sure
With you I'm forever bound
With you my heart is sound
And you my faith is found
I don't care what this world says
If they tell me to stop
I won't when they tell me to turn
If I'm you, I don't ask you
I'll always walk with you
I'm strange and peculiar.
Thank you.
